o1: Enables NAD+ nucleosidase activity; enzyme binding activity; identical protein binding activity; and MAP kinase kinase kinase activity. Involved in NAD catabolic process; defense response to other organism; defense response to bacterium; p38 MAPK cascade; and regulation of gene expression. Acts upstream of or within serotonin biosynthetic process. Is located in axon cytoplasm and cell body. Is expressed in head; intestine; and pharynx. Is part of the p38 MAPK pathway. Used to study amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Orthologous to human SARM1 (sterile alpha and TIR motif containing 1).
